note: P is mostly one idea: three light/pastel lavender-gradient pill buttons in centered cards or hero (P2, P3, P4 near-identical in palette, serif headline, and curve families) plus one dark variant (P1), all in a sleep/retreat context. Q mixes light glass card, two dark pages, and different button forms (pill-in-pill, deep indigo, outlined sparkle), with different page contexts (newsletter, journal waitlist, wind-down) and a few distinctive curves, though it still repeats the Lumen name, serif, and purple-dark mood.
